features: Exactly audited_features62, pz0-only first-power momentum, raw11, typed NaN, legitimate signed negatives. Same original truth/reco pz>50 and all cuts. No new timing.

split.algorithm: Union all response views by conservative canonical-flux:eventID across eras (strip only 24_xing_angle_wo_caloNu_ prefix), actual EVNT path:eventID, and exact float32 native-MeV incoming(PDG,px,py,pz); split connected families with deterministic seeded permutation within component. No target/prediction used. Keep all rows; no quarantine. Source files can contain several roles; no shared parent or incoming across roles.
split.limitation: Full upstream GENIE seed lineage and new blind confirmation are not established. Same-flux event ordinals across eras are conservatively linked; unrelated flux event ordinals are not assumed to share a parent. Exact incoming collisions across any flux are always linked.

weights.base: Each incoming key shares total weight1 across views within role.
weights.flat: From training only: base_weight * sum(train base)/(occupied_train_bins * train_bin_base_mass). Preserve base total weight and regularization scale; no clipping.
weights.evaluation: Original incoming spectrum and frozen train-map reweighted spectrum; per-bin metrics in both. Do not fit weights to cal/test histograms.
weights.calibration: For both arms report raw, common incoming-weighted cal offset and frozen-train-map flat cal offset. Primary training-effect contrast uses common incoming calibration; matching flat calibration is separately reported.

model.initialization: Weighted training mean logE for each arm; boost_from_average=0. No tuning, early stopping or test selection.
model.platform: Kubeflow GPU if actual GPU small-sample QA succeeds; CPU fallback otherwise, same device for both arms.

evaluation.controls: Traditional pz0/0.8, same-split incoming-weighted direct62; Stage87 only historical. Per-run/flux/component breakdown. Family-paired conditional intervals; no independent-source or real-system certification.
evaluation.gates: Retain original two trueE low-bin noninferiority upper95<=1.05 vs traditional; flat/incoming two-low point<=.95 and upper95<1 plus all<=1.01, protection strata<=1.03 and all original eight strata three tails upper95 delta<=2pp. Report cal/test/raw/offset variants without choosing winner.

execution.pilot: Full local files and first1000 parent reco prefixes, complete cuts/identity/features/calibration QA and timing before production.
execution.storage: Only compact selected arrays, models, predictions, tables and plots. No persistent ROOT/xAOD. Reuse existing Stage130 input, archive terminal logs once.
